beschikking.title: Beschikking
beschikking.description: Formal decision (Awb besluit) with full lifecycle: ontwerp -> akkoord-mandaat -> ondertekend -> verzonden -> ontvangen-bevestiging -> gearchiveerd. Immutable once ondertekend. State transitions are guarded by mandaat-verificatie (akkoord) and TSP-handtekening (onderteken) and logged via stateMachineLog.

caseId.title: Case ID
caseId.description: Back-reference to the dossiq case this beschikking belongs to

draftVersion.title: Draft Version
draftVersion.description: Auto-increment as the draft is re-rendered or field-edited

announcementDate.title: Announcement Date
announcementDate.description: Date the beschikking becomes legally effective (Awb 3:41)

objectionTermEndDate.title: Objection Period End Date
objectionTermEndDate.description: End of the 6-week bezwaartermijn (Awb 6:7), computed on verzending

reminderDate.title: Reminder Date
reminderDate.description: Reminder date, one week before bezwaarTermijnEindDatum

feeAmount.title: Levy Amount
feeAmount.description: Leges amount associated with the decision

format.title: Format
format.description: File format of the rendered document, e.g. pdf-a3

fileId.title: File ID
fileId.description: Nextcloud file id of the rendered PDF

checksumSha256.title: SHA-256 Checksum
checksumSha256.description: SHA-256 hash of the rendered file for integrity verification

paginas.title: Page Count
paginas.description: Number of pages in the rendered document

addressee.title: Addressee
addressee.description: Addressee (a citizen or a business). BSN/OIN are special-category identifiers and are masked when logged.

type.title: Addressee Type
type.description: Whether the addressee is a citizen (burger) or a business (bedrijf)

bsn.title: BSN
bsn.description: Burger identifier (special category, masked in logs)

messageBoxConfirmed.title: Message Box Confirmed
messageBoxConfirmed.description: Whether the addressee's berichtenbox address has been confirmed

kind.title: Decision Sort
kind.description: Type of the decision, e.g. toekenning or afwijzing

size.title: Scope
size.description: Extent or scope of the decision, e.g. number of hours per week

effectiveDate.title: Start Date
effectiveDate.description: Date from which the decision takes effect

endDate.title: End Date
endDate.description: Date on which the decision expires

mandateGranted.title: Mandate Granted
mandateGranted.description: Point-in-time mandaat record captured at the akkoord step (ADR design D3)

mandateSchemeId.title: Mandate Regulation ID
mandateSchemeId.description: Reference to the mandaatRegeling in effect at the time of approval

approvedDate.title: Approval Date
approvedDate.description: Timestamp at which the mandate approval was recorded

signature.title: Signature
signature.description: eIDAS-qualified electronic signature metadata; durably retained for future validation

tspProvider.title: TSP Provider
tspProvider.description: Name of the Trust Service Provider that issued the signature

tspProviderEidasId.title: TSP Provider eIDAS ID
tspProviderEidasId.description: eIDAS identifier of the TSP provider

signatory.title: Signatory
signatory.description: Nextcloud UID of the person who signed the document

signingMoment.title: Signing Timestamp
signingMoment.description: Date and time at which the document was signed

certificateSerialNumber.title: Certificate Serial Number
certificateSerialNumber.description: Serial number of the signing certificate

validationRapportId.title: Validation Report ID
validationRapportId.description: Reference to the signature validation report

notificationChannel.title: Dispatch Channel
notificationChannel.description: Channel used for dispatch, e.g. berichtenbox-mijnoverheid

sentOn.title: Sent On
sentOn.description: Timestamp at which the beschikking was sent

sentBy.title: Sent By
sentBy.description: Actor who sent the beschikking (user id or 'systeem')

receiptConfirmationOn.title: Receipt Confirmation On
receiptConfirmationOn.description: Timestamp at which receipt was confirmed

readConfirmationOn.title: Read Confirmation On
readConfirmationOn.description: Timestamp at which the message was read by the recipient

archive.title: Archive
archive.description: Archival record (TMLO/MDTO) populated when the beschikking is archived via the OpenRegister archival pipeline

archivedOn.title: Archived On
archivedOn.description: Timestamp at which the beschikking was archived

archiveId.title: Archive ID
archiveId.description: Identifier assigned by the archival system

destructionDate.title: Destruction Date
destructionDate.description: Date on which the archived record is scheduled for destruction

stateMachineLog.title: State Machine Log
stateMachineLog.description: Immutable record of a single beschikking state transition, including actor, trigger, and supporting evidence (mandaat reference or TSP rapport).

decisionId.title: Decision ID
decisionId.description: The beschikking this transition belongs to

moment.title: Timestamp
moment.description: Date and time of the state transition

actorType.title: Actor Type
actorType.description: Whether the actor is a employee or the system

trigger.title: Trigger
trigger.description: Whether the transition was initiated manually or automatically

evidenceMaterial.title: Evidence Material
evidenceMaterial.description: Supporting evidence for this transition, such as a mandate or signature report

kind.title: Evidence Type
kind.description: Type of evidence, e.g. mandaat or tsp-rapport

bezwaarTrigger.title: Bezwaar Trigger
bezwaarTrigger.description: Scheduling record created when a beschikking is verzonden. Drives the daily BezwaarTermijnJob: when the bezwaartermijn lapses without a bezwaarschrift, archival is triggered.

decisionId.title: Decision ID
decisionId.description: The beschikking this trigger belongs to

announcementDate.title: Announcement Date
announcementDate.description: Date the beschikking was publicly announced

reminderDate.title: Reminder Date
reminderDate.description: Reminder date, one week before the bezwaarTermijnEindDatum

objectionReceived.title: Objection Received
objectionReceived.description: Whether a bezwaarschrift has been received

archiveTriggerActive.title: Archive Trigger Active
archiveTriggerActive.description: Whether the archival trigger is still active

archiveDate.title: Archive Date
archiveDate.description: Date on which archival becomes due

mandateArrangement.title: Mandaatregeling
mandateArrangement.description: Defines which approval levels (niveau) may sign which decision types up to which bedrag (Awb 10:3-10:12). Point-in-time: the regeling-id + version is captured on the beschikking at akkoord.

name.title: Name
name.description: Human-readable name of the mandate regulation

grantedBy.title: Granted By
grantedBy.description: Body that granted the mandate, e.g. college-bw

grantedDate.title: Grant Date
grantedDate.description: Date on which the mandate was granted

withdrawalDate.title: Revocation Date
withdrawalDate.description: Date on which the mandate was revoked, if applicable

subMandateAllowed.title: Sub-mandate Permitted
subMandateAllowed.description: Whether delegation to a lower level is permitted

to_amount.title: Up To Amount
to_amount.description: Upper bedrag limit; omit the property for unlimited

caseTypes.title: Case Types
caseTypes.description: Case types for which this authorization level applies

decisionTypes.title: Decision Types
decisionTypes.description: Decision types for which this authorization level applies

objects.rationale: Op basis van het onderzoek van 28 maart 2026 is vastgesteld dat client recht heeft op huishoudelijke ondersteuning.
De aanvrager heeft voldaan aan de eisen van de Omgevingswet.
